what: Ambev is the largest brewer in Latin America, part of the AB InBev group. It brews Skol, Brahma and Antarctica in Brazil, Quilmes in Argentina, and bottles Pepsi products across several countries.
customers: Bars, restaurants, supermarkets and small shops across Brazil, Argentina, Central America, the Caribbean and Canada.
money: Skol, Brahma, Antarctica and premium imports
Latin America South and Central America
Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay and Central America
moat: Distribution reaching over a million small shops in Brazil, built over decades, which no new brewer can replicate.
risks: Brazilian consumer spending drives beer volumes
Argentine inflation and currency devaluation distort results
Competition from Heineken has taken share in Brazilian premium beer
Barley and aluminium costs are volatile
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 20% with a 26% operating margin
Almost no debt: about $462 million against $3.7 billion of cash
A dividend yield around 5% paid from strong cash generation
watch: Brazilian beer volumes and revenue per hectolitre.
